title: Statistical Inference for Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2507.20560v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Privacy preservation in machine learning, particularly through Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD), is crucial for analyzing sensitive data. However, existing statistical inference methods for SGD predominantly focus on cyclic subsampling, while DP-SGD requires randomized subsampling. This paper first bridges this gap by establishing the asymptotic properties of SGD under the randomized rule and extending these results to DP-SGD. For DP-SGD, we show that the asymptotic variance decomposes into statistical, sampling, and privacy-induced components. We propose two methods for constructing valid confidence intervals: the plug-in method and the random scaling method. We also perform extensive numerical analysis showing that the proposed confidence intervals achieve nominal coverage rates while maintaining privacy.

translated_title: 差分隐私随机梯度下降的统计推断
translated_abstract: 机器学习中的隐私保护，特别是通过差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）实现的隐私保护，对于分析敏感数据至关重要。然而，现有的SGD统计推断方法主要集中于循环子采样，而DP-SGD需要随机化子采样。本文首次通过建立随机化规则下SGD的渐近性质并将这些结果扩展到DP-SGD来弥合这一差距。对于DP-SGD，我们证明了渐近方差可分解为统计分量、采样分量和隐私诱导分量三个部分。我们提出了两种构建有效置信区间的方法：代入法和随机缩放法。我们还进行了广泛的数值分析，结果表明所提出的置信区间在保持隐私的同时达到了名义覆盖率。
tldr: 本文首次建立了随机化子采样规则下SGD的渐近性质并将其扩展到DP-SGD，证明了其渐近方差可分解为统计、采样和隐私诱导三个分量，并提出了代入法和随机缩放法两种构建有效置信区间的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper first establishes the asymptotic properties of SGD under randomized subsampling and extends them to DP-SGD, showing that its asymptotic variance decomposes into statistical, sampling, and privacy-induced components, and proposes plug-in and random scaling methods for constructing valid confidence intervals.
